description: Boundary-sized payloads for the masking contract: an empty payload with no fields at all, a sensitive field whose value is the empty string, a sensitive field whose value is a single character, a sensitive field whose value is only whitespace, and a sensitive field carrying a long value. Each sensitive value is replaced by a run of asterisks whose length equals the byte length of the original value, while key order and non-sensitive content are preserved. The output is the resulting payload serialized as a JSON object.
